implemented: Runtime array designators in offsetof with target-sized unsigned arithmetic and single evaluation
Constant offsets preserved for ICEs and static initialization; pointer traversal and bitfields reject
Binding-aware evaluated-operand proof for static initializers and constant controls
One-GPR x86 struct/union asm operands of 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes with raw representation preservation
Single-evaluation output views, returned/compound inputs, conservative packed alignment and volatile snapshots
Generic memory fallback and clean rejection of aggregate immediates
limits: Register records are bounded to 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes; multi-register modes, atomic-member register packing and differing-width ties remain unsupported, even though GNU supports some such forms.
Const-member outputs reject in memory and register paths. Generic memory operands retain existing addressability requirements.
Clang constant_p offsetof sideeffect behavior is excluded from shared compiler reference; Keel retains its documented unevaluated conservative integer query.
Packed enum sizeof/ABI, static initializer and remaining syntax/constraint gaps remain. No kernel ABI, objtool, link or boot qualification.

validation.scoped_clippy: Completed with existing warnings; no new module/test diagnostics.
validation.wasm_node_execution: Passed on macOS in focused and full tests. The Node-dependent test is filtered from the isolated Linux shell, which has no Node executable.
validation.compiler_references: Shared offsetof references use OFFSETOF_REFERENCE to omit only the nested constant_p wrapper; Keel objects execute that wrapper and check no evaluation. Direct offset/index sideeffects compare against GCC and Clang.
